JanSport Laptop Backpack - Computer Bag with 2 Compartments

JanSport backpacks have been a campus staple for good reason — they're simple, durable, and they just work. The Threaded pattern adds some visual flair — a far cry from the plain black you see everywhere — making it easy to spot on a crowded backpack rack. The haul handle is handy for grabbing it off the bus floor, and the front pocket has organizers for pens, phone, and keys. JanSport's been trusted for decades, and with over 19,000 reviews averaging 4.7 stars, this pattern version keeps everything great while looking way more interesting.
